comparison_policy.purpose: Recent-work context, not a performance ranking.
comparison_policy.cross_hardware_rule: Source-reported runtimes are not compared as speedups across different machines, protocol stacks, or security relations.
comparison_policy.same_runner_rule: The ZKLP smoke benchmark and our subset benchmark run on the same GitHub Actions runner, but use different gnark versions and certify different relations; their timings remain descriptive only.

same_runner_smoke.note: Independent same-runner smoke benchmark over the first upstream ZKLP32 test vector; upstream gnark fork based on v0.9.1. Different relation and library version from this paper.

recent_work_context.evaluation: 450 RIPE Atlas Waldos; 22/37/450 challengers; 37 deployed cloud challengers (34 US, 2 Canada, 1 Mexico).
recent_work_context.reported_result: <100 km uncertainty for about 20%, 25%, 45% with 22, 37, 450 challengers; <1000 km for about 80%, 85%, 95%.
recent_work_context.comparability: Different problem: Internet-delay localization; no ZK witness-hiding comparison.

recent_work_context.evaluation: AWS deployment up to 261 sensors and cyber-physical deployment up to 19 resource-constrained sensors.
recent_work_context.reported_result: Privacy-preserving Byzantine sensor fusion with guaranteed output delivery.
recent_work_context.comparability: Different distributed GC architecture and output interface; runtime not normalized against our SNARK.

recent_work_context.evaluation: 200, 3600, and 43,800 trajectory points; Raspberry Pi/phone/PC provers and remote verifier; interactive ZK backends.
recent_work_context.reported_result: For 43,800 points, about 36 min for EV subsidy and 59 min for highway taxation.
recent_work_context.comparability: Closest policy-compliance application, but trajectory-wide interactive proofs differ from our one-event noninteractive certificate.

recent_work_context.evaluation: Google Cloud; fault-free and faulty executions; up to 261 sensors.
recent_work_context.reported_result: Largest tested total measured phase time reported around one second.
recent_work_context.comparability: Different collusion-resilient garbled-circuit sensor-fusion protocol; no direct proof-size/prover-time comparison.
